The scene is set outdoors, with lush green trees in the background. The student with the purple hair is seen looking forward, while the student with the brown hair is looking slightly to the side. The on-screen text reads, "简直不知道天高地厚," which translates to "I don't know how thick the sky and earth are," suggesting a sense of disbelief or confusion.

The scene then cuts to a close-up of the same male student, now standing in front of a blue sky. He is raising his right fist in a gesture of determination or defiance. The on-screen text reads, "自己可是把人生堆在这次考试上了," which translates to "I've put my entire life on this exam." This indicates a deep personal investment and the immense pressure he is under.

Next, the video shows the student from behind, looking into a locker. The locker is a standard school locker, and the student is looking at the contents inside. The on-screen text reads, "这样的话," which translates to "Then, this way," suggesting a continuation of the narrative.

The scene then shifts to a close-up of the student's hands holding a letter. The letter is addressed to him and is written in Japanese. The on-screen text reads, "男主发现鞋柜里有封写给自己的信," which translates to "The main character discovers a letter written to him in the shoe cabinet." The letter is handwritten and has a colorful tape on the envelope. The text on the letter reads, "海野君へ 仮に...来がありません 放学後、屋上で 会ってよろしいですか 溺れんじ了," which translates to "To Hayashi-kun, if... I can't come, after school, on the roof, can we meet? I'm okay."

The final frame shows the student's feet, standing on a blue floor. The on-screen text reads, "很快男主就意识到这是恶作剧," which translates to "The main character quickly realizes this is a prank." This suggests that the letter is a prank, and the student is now aware of the deception.
